text: Axis Bank charged me Rs 1,200 twice on 28 September 2026. I complained to Axis Bank on 1 October 2026. They replied on 10 October 2026 and refunded the money. I am satisfied with the resolution.
note: Expected dates hand-computed from RB-IOS 2026 (30-day wait, 90-day window from the later of wait end and last reply).
